messages:
Claire: FYI customer (Acme Retail) — invoice INV-2026-0843 was paid but their PO# isn’t on the invoice. They need the PO on record for their AP. billing says payment succeeded (card). They asked if we can just edit the invoice or if we need a credit + reissue. Amount $18,240, VAT included. Screenshot: https://acme.screens/px/12345 :thinking:
Sam: Can you paste the invoice metadata and payment id? quick check if it’s finalized/locked.
Claire: Payment ID pay_8g7f2h, status=paid. Invoice status=finalized. Created 2026-03-10 16:12 UTC. PO they want added: PO-88912.
billing-bot: Automated note: invoice INV-2026-0843 | status=paid | amount=18240.00 | currency=USD | tax=0.0 (customer reported VAT; customer is EU entity) | payment_method=card-visa | payment_id=pay_8g7f2h.
Mateo: If invoice is finalized/paid we cannot edit the issued invoice legally in most jurisdictions. Standard flow is: issue credit (full amount) -> create replacement invoice with PO -> apply credit to replacement (or mark refunded/zeroed) and record reissue. For EU VAT we need to ensure new invoice has VAT lines and reverse-charge if applicable.
Priya: Confirming — finance prefers credit and reissue for audit trail. Also need customer VAT number and billing country to determine VAT handling. Claire can you ask for VAT ID or confirm they were charged VAT?
Claire: Customer replied: VAT ID = GB999888777, billing country = United Kingdom. They say they were charged VAT on the original invoice.
Mateo: OK. Plan: 1) Create credit note against INV-2026-0843 (reason: add PO/replace invoice) 2) Create new invoice INV-2026-0843-R1 with same line items + PO-88912 + VAT fields set (VAT ID included) 3) Apply credit to mark original as credited and link to new invoice. 4) If they need money refunded to card, issue refund after credit creation (separate request).
Mateo: Repro steps for finance UI (internal): 1) Billing UI -> Invoices -> search INV-2026-0843 -> Actions -> Create credit note -> Amount: 18240.00 -> Reason: Reissue w/ PO 88912 -> Submit. 2) Billing UI -> Create new invoice -> Copy from INV-2026-0843 -> Add PO field: PO-88912 -> Fill VAT ID: GB999888777 -> Set status: issued -> Send to customer. 3) In credit note detail -> Apply -> Select INV-2026-0843-R1 -> Save.
Mateo: If you prefer the API, use (internal only):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal.billing.redwood/v1/credits" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-2026-0843","amount":18240.00,"reason":"Reissue with PO-88912"}'
```
Then create invoice via POST /v1/invoices with field "po_number": "PO-88912" and "customer_vat": "GB999888777".
Priya: GL codes for this should be the same as original invoice. Tag credit note with tag=reissue_po so we can filter later (audit). Also add note: "requested by support — Claire".
Claire: Acknowledged — will request confirmation from customer if they want card refund or just an accounting reissue.
Sam: Who will send the updated invoice to the customer once it’s created?
Priya: Finance can email once new invoice is issued. ETA: I can create the credit and new invoice today if we have the VAT ID and confirmation on refund.
Claire: Customer confirms NO refund needed, they only need invoice with PO and VAT line for AP. Proceed with credit + reissue (credit applied to new invoice).
Mateo: Starting credit creation now, will ping when done. :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: Action logged: credit_created | id=cr_90234 | linked_invoice=INV-2026-0843 | created_by=Mateo | ts=1769934185
Mateo: Credit created (cr_90234). New invoice created INV-2026-0843-R1 and sent to acme.ap@acmeretail.com. PO field populated: PO-88912, VAT ID recorded.
Priya: Tagged credit with reissue_po and updated GL. Marking this as finance-complete.
Claire: Thanks team — forwarding new invoice to the customer thread and confirming closure. Customer replied: "Received, this works — thanks." :thumbsup:
Sam: Closing support ticket and noting workaround in KB: "Paid invoice reissue with PO — credit+reissue flow". PR to docs to add example steps.
Mateo: Added internal ticket BILL-2026-77 for audit record.
Claire: Closing here. :white_check_mark:
